[[File:Lando_Cloud_City_EotECR.png|thumb|right|300px|Lando Calrissian, Baron Administrator of Cloud City on Bespin during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].]]
'''Baron Administrator''' was the title of whoever was in charge of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] and other comparable facilities. By [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Cloud City's Baron Administrator was [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], who had won the title and position from his predecessor, [[Dominic Raynor]], in a game of [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]].

This title was later used by [[Daran Tal]] when he came into control of the [[Crystal Web Station]], and was further implemented for the ruler of the [[platform city]] of [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]].

The post of Baron Administrator was symbolized by a belt with a distinctive buckle design. An [[Aeien silk/Legends|Aeien silk]] cape was also often used as a symbol of the office.
